{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdM5kshQWD9ucFAX3zTBr","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018ZQ3Ctr9YEJXmK2eNQv93q","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/qa-quiz-001/2026-07-24T150024Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/answer.md","content":"# USDC balance renders as nothing — the whole arc\n\n## TL;DR\n\n`USDC` was never registered in Scaffold-ETH's contract registry, so the\nhook read from an empty entry and quietly no-op'd. The teammate pasted it\ninto the **wrong file** (`deployedContracts.ts`), which is machine-generated\nand gets rewritten on every `yarn deploy` — so the fix erased itself. USDC is\na contract you *don't* deploy, so it belongs in **`externalContracts.ts`**,\nkeyed by Base's chain id `8453`.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Why the hook returned `undefined` silently (no error, no request)\n\n`useScaffoldReadContract` does not read a contract directly. It first resolves\nthe contract's `{ address, abi }` from Scaffold's registry:\n\n```\nuseScaffoldReadContract  ->  useDeployedContractInfo(\"USDC\")  ->  wagmi useReadContract\n```\n\nThe registry is the merge of `deployedContracts.ts` + `externalContracts.ts`,\nlooked up by the **target network's chain id**. When `\"USDC\"` isn't present\nunder that chain id:\n\n- `useDeployedContractInfo` returns `data: undefined` (it just doesn't find the\n  key — it does **not** throw).\n- `useScaffoldReadContract` then calls wagmi's `useReadContract` with\n  `address: undefined` and `abi: undefined`.\n- wagmi **disables** the query when `address`/`abi` are missing (the query is\n  never `enabled`). So:\n  - no eth_call / RPC request is ever fired  → **network tab shows nothing**,\n  - no exception is thrown                    → **no runtime error**,\n  - `data` is simply never populated          → **`usdcBalance` stays `undefined`**.\n\nThis is by design: Scaffold treats \"contract not registered\" as \"nothing to\nread yet\" rather than an error. The failure is a *missing registration*, not a\nbad call — which is exactly why it fails silently and why the network tab is a\nred herring.\n\n(A missing `connectedAddress` in `args` would disable the query the same way,\nbut here the give-away is that registering USDC fixes it.)\n\n## 2. Why the teammate's fix worked all week, then self-destructed on deploy\n\n`packages/nextjs/contracts/deployedContracts.ts` is **auto-generated**. On\n`yarn deploy`, hardhat-deploy runs and a post-deploy codegen step\n(`generateTsAbis`) **overwrites the entire file** from the fresh deployment\nartifacts in `packages/hardhat/deployments/`.\n\n- Pasting a `USDC` entry there works immediately (the registry is just the\n  merged object, and the hand-added key is now in it) → \"worked all week.\"\n- The next `yarn deploy` regenerates the file from deployment artifacts. USDC\n  is **not one of your deployed contracts** (it's Circle's token, already live\n  on Base — you never deployed it, there's no artifact for it), so it doesn't\n  make it into the regenerated file. The manual entry vanishes and the page\n  goes blank again.\n\nRule of thumb: `deployedContracts.ts` is a build output. Never hand-edit it;\nanything you put there is temporary and dies at the next deploy.\n\n## 3. The correct registration\n\nPut third-party / already-deployed contracts (tokens, external protocols) in\nthe file codegen never touches:\n\n**`packages/nextjs/contracts/externalContracts.ts`**\n\nKey it by chain id. **Base mainnet = `8453`**, and native (Circle) USDC on Base\nis `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913` (6 decimals).\n\n```ts\nimport { GenericContractsDeclaration } from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth/contract\";\n\nconst externalContracts = {\n  8453: {\n    USDC: {\n      address: \"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913\",\n      abi: [\n        {\n          type: \"function\",\n          name: \"balanceOf\",\n          stateMutability: \"view\",\n          inputs: [{ name: \"account\", type: \"address\" }],\n          outputs: [{ name: \"\", type: \"uint256\" }],\n        },\n        {\n          type: \"function\",\n          name: \"decimals\",\n          stateMutability: \"view\",\n          inputs: [],\n          outputs: [{ name: \"\", type: \"uint8\" }],\n        },\n        {\n          type: \"function\",\n          name: \"symbol\",\n          stateMutability: \"view\",\n          inputs: [],\n          outputs: [{ name: \"\", type: \"string\" }],\n        },\n        {\n          type: \"function\",\n          name: \"transfer\",\n          stateMutability: \"nonpayable\",\n          inputs: [\n            { name: \"to\", type: \"address\" },\n            { name: \"amount\", type: \"uint256\" },\n          ],\n          outputs: [{ name: \"\", type: \"bool\" }],\n        },\n        {\n          type: \"function\",\n          name: \"approve\",\n          stateMutability: \"nonpayable\",\n          inputs: [\n            { name: \"spender\", type: \"address\" },\n            { name: \"amount\", type: \"uint256\" },\n          ],\n          outputs: [{ name: \"\", type: \"bool\" }],\n        },\n        {\n          type: \"event\",\n          name: \"Transfer\",\n          inputs: [\n            { name: \"from\", type: \"address\", indexed: true },\n            { name: \"to\", type: \"address\", indexed: true },\n            { name: \"value\", type: \"uint256\", indexed: false },\n          ],\n          anonymous: false,\n        },\n      ],\n    },\n  },\n} as const;\n\nexport default externalContracts satisfies GenericContractsDeclaration;\n```\n\nNotes:\n\n- `externalContracts.ts` is **not** regenerated by `yarn deploy` — it survives.\n  Scaffold merges it with `deployedContracts.ts`, so `contractName: \"USDC\"`\n  resolves for both read and write hooks.\n- `as const` matters: Scaffold derives TypeScript types (function names, arg\n  types) from the literal ABI, so it gives you autocomplete/type-safety and\n  keeps `satisfies GenericContractsDeclaration` happy. A minimal ABI (just\n  `balanceOf`) is enough to unblock `/payouts`; the extra entries above let you\n  format the amount (`decimals`) and do transfers later.\n- The **chain id must match your target network.** `useDeployedContractInfo`\n  looks up by `targetNetwork.id`, so `scaffold.config.ts` `targetNetworks` must\n  include `chains.base` (8453). If you also run on Base Sepolia (84532), add a\n  `84532` block with the testnet USDC address\n  (`0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e`).\n- Result is 6-decimals raw units — divide by 1e6 (e.g. `formatUnits(bal, 6)`)\n  for display.\n\n### If you must verify the exact hook/codegen behavior in this repo\nGrep the actual sources (paths in a hardhat-flavor Scaffold-ETH 2 app):\n- `packages/nextjs/hooks/scaffold-eth/useScaffoldReadContract.ts` — confirms the\n  `useDeployedContractInfo` → wagmi `useReadContract` chain and the `enabled` gate.\n- `packages/nextjs/hooks/scaffold-eth/useDeployedContractInfo.ts` — confirms the\n  chain-id keyed lookup and the `undefined` (non-throwing) return.\n- `packages/hardhat/deploy/` + the `generateTsAbis`/`00_generate_abis` script —\n  confirms `deployedContracts.ts` is overwritten on deploy.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":698,"cache_read_input_tokens":21407,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":698},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"4cdadd01-f68c-42f0-8517-275c46b4b589","uuid":"1e42739a-0332-4c8b-8cb1-31119415f26b","timestamp":"2026-07-24T15:01:59.805Z","request_id":"req_011CdM5krPXNDtpUSuVNB4z8"}
